Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Myriella usually hope their child will grow to embody a variation of the name myra, meaning 'beloved' or 'ruler' in greek. and live with faith, good character and purpose.

She was a Roman noblewoman who refused to sacrifice to the pagan gods, and was subjected to various tortures, including being thrown into a cauldron of boiling oil, which failed to harm her. She was later beheaded.

modern_usage.modern_context: Myriella is a character from the Mistborn series written by Brandon Sanderson. She is a member of the noble House Venture and is known for her proficiency in Allomancy, a type of magic that allows users to ingest metals to enhance their abilities. Myriella's name has gained popularity in modern culture due to her role in the fantasy literature genre and her presence in young adult fiction, as well as her unique magic system. She is currently seen on various platforms, including print (books), digital (e-books and audiobooks), and television (as a character on HBO's 'The Wheel of Time' series, based on Robert Jordan's novels, though Myriella is not a character in those books, but rather a character from Sanderson's Mistborn series who is expected to appear in upcoming adaptations of those works).
